x: One of our most promising boys J.Lewis,is one of the Football fans and I am told on good authority that he is a most excellent player. Another is J.Barnard who I know has been sought as a member by a number of prominent clubs.

Running in an invitation 880y at a Vet's meeting,J.Lewis was 1st in 2:11 in spite of strong opposition from Mitcham AC. J.Lewis was 1st in the S/London Schools 880y - 2:11.0,and reached the final of the All England,finishing 7th with 2:08.0
In the Boys events winners were A.Bent (100y) and J.Lewis (880y). Generally then,a disappointing meeting especially for the handfull of spectators who did take the trouble to come.
Tony led at his own pace all the way and John never really got on terms with him. John Lewis was a worthy 3rd. and Robert Hamilton 4th. Arnold Bent was the only competitor in the High Jump.
1 Swansea 25:50; 2 Trafford 25:52; 3 Mansfield 26:12; 35 Belgrave 28:06. Fastest: J.Lewis (Swansea) 25:50; R.Gould (Trafford) 25:52; B.Farquarson (Mansfield) 26:12; K.Tadesse 28:06 (35th).
Long stages: 1 M.Miles (Belgrave) 25:45; 2 J.Lewis (Swansea) 25:50; 3 R.Gould (Trafford) 25:52; 4 I.Hudspith (Morpeth) 25:55; 5 R.Birchall (Birchfield) 25:56; 6 J.Wild (Sale) 25:58.
